info.title: Audience Lab public core additional implementation contract
info.description: Document baseline only; proposed operations are not deployed. Frozen registry and runtime copies unchanged.

patch.x-role-exception: authenticated actor own read receipt only; actor identity is server managed

x-contextual-invariants: Every path workspace is authorized (mismatch403); referenced cross-scope objects404. All new objects retain workspace/Case scope.
All date-times timezone-aware. Whitespace-only strings rejected. Strict integer budgets reject bool/string. Closed DTO extra fields rejected.

Intake DRAFT_REVIEW requires draft; QUESTION_ONLY/SOURCE_REVIEW forbid non-null draft. Existing Case title mismatch409 CASE_TITLE_MISMATCH. Intake updates active state/content and head row_version; Case.as_of immutable.

Idempotency scope workspace, scope_case_key NEW_CASE or CaseUUID, operation,key. Key1..200. Normalize defaults/UTC/set IDs; preserve ordered arrays; canonical UTF8 sorted compact JSON with NaN forbidden. Same key/hash reuses same resource; changed hash409.

Source requires exactly one HTTPS URL or transcript locator. OPEN requires body1..200000; UNKNOWN/RESTRICTED body absent, metadata-only. User licensed/nonpublic submission blocked absent approved policy. Recorded time<=server received time.

Included published/available/received timestamps<=as_of; no late source backfill into a prior view. Reassessment as_of>=baseline. RealityExecution pins source/result sets before enqueue and requires SOURCE_REVIEW eligible OPEN source.

Review intervals exact Unicode codepoints, end excluded; fixed text/kind/key. Max50000 draft,100 passages,total200000,500 assertions. No truncation; actual tokenizer/reserved output context check; missing model config503.

COMPLETED/PARTIAL review contains every assertion once, completion non-null and error null. PARTIAL requires coverage warning. Pending items empty, completion/error null; FAILED/BLOCKED items empty with completion and fixed error.

Supporting and contradicting branches are disjoint subsets of fixed eligible committed Claim ids. SUPPORTED requires same-scope entailment/no unresolved opposite; CONFLICT has both source accounts (not both factual certainties); CONTRADICTED opposite only. INSUFFICIENT needs needed evidence.

Numeric/causal subchecks separate; aggregate CONFLICT>CONTRADICTED>INSUFFICIENT>SUPPORTED. Calculation Decimal exact same scope and previous>0, HALF_UP display2. No causal conclusion from a reduction.

Question graph acyclic. Per-view assessment append-only with REVIEW/REALITY_EXECUTION/BRIEF origin. RESOLVED needs Claim/Passage; parent CONFLICTED priority, allresolved=>RESOLVED, someresolved=>PARTIALLY_RESOLVED, elseOPEN. Task completion/search0/synthetic answer is not resolution.

Task has exactly one non-null completed review_id or brief_id. Minimum one question and at least one origin-view reference. Null content permitted for draftless Brief. Verified workspace assignee only. OPEN->DONE/CANCELLED with If-Match, stale409, terminal409.
ReportingResult is immutable; question IDs belong to task origin view; note USER_NOTE never evidence. DONE task accepts later results; CANCELLED409. Submission/result sets1..20.

Reassessment commits child pack/review/assessments/delta atomically. RealityExecution commits pack and draftless questions atomically. Head CAS matches baseline pack/review,rowversion and active inputs; loser branch saved with head_updatedfalse and BRANCH_ONLY, no merge.

EditorialBrief compiles explicit pack/state, exactly five unique sections, original pure compiler rank/counter/decision baseline retained, action overlay separate. Fixed core id equals editorial_briefs id; BRIEF output and task use that view.
ReviewDelta joins assertion_key for same content version; changed content NOT_COMPARABLE with before/after-only. UUID/time change alone not semantic change.

Search accumulated usage across retry <= fixed budgets. Snippet not evidence. Zero relevant sources COMPLETED, question OPEN; partial channel failuresPARTIAL; allfailedFAILED. No automatic DraftReview rerun.
Notification unique per Case/dedupe before-after hash; P0/P1 app only; readtrue idempotent per actor, never external message.

Export fixed snapshot and dependency rights at submit/completion/everydownload. Derived source content also guarded. COMPLETED needs nonempty artifact/readback SHA/size/media/filename/time; revoked dependency403 whole file. No user storage path or anonymous bypass URL.
New cursor opaque scope-bound(created_at,id), limit1..100. Existing monitoring offset cursor/limits remain unchanged. New API operations never overwrite deployed Runtime methods.
